body:
Confirm the integration of the recently published (July 2021) ["Guidelines on Minimum Standards for Developer Verification of Software"](https://www.nist.gov/system/files/documents/2021/07/13/Developer%20Verification%20of%20Software.pdf) from NIST, specifically their  "_Recommended Minimum Standard for Developer Testing_":

- [ ] Threat Modeling
- [ ] Automated Testing
- [ ] Code-Based, or Static, Analysis
- [ ] Review for Hardcoded Secrets
- [ ] Run with Language-Provided Checks and Protection
- [ ] Black Box Test Cases
- [ ] Code-Based Test Cases
- [ ] Historical Test Cases
- [ ] Fuzzing
- [ ] Web Application Scanning
- [ ] Check Included Software Components

comments.body: Why, and what is your clear proposal?

I have updated the placeholder text.

Can @elarlang create a "_NIST_" Milestone as there will be a number of child issue[s] created against the task list above in addition to other points raised within ["Guidelines on Minimum Standards for Developer Verification of Software"](https://www.nist.gov/system/files/documents/2021/07/13/Developer%20Verification%20of%20Software.pdf) please?

I'd also be interested to know if NIST reached out to other ASVS Project Leader[s] @danielcuthbert @jmanico @tghosth @vanderaj et al as there is no reference to ASVS within ["Guidelines on Minimum Standards for Developer Verification of Software"](https://www.nist.gov/system/files/documents/2021/07/13/Developer%20Verification%20of%20Software.pdf) please?
This is not a clear issue we can work on. Closing this out.
I'm not planning to take an action until the next major/minor release of ASVS after 4.0.2 is published as this will be either a major change or fork @jmanico
